title.en: The lecture hall · One seal at a time

how.zh: 对着摄像头，照褚先生说的，一个印一个印地结，每个稳住一下才算；结错了，再来。五个都会了，四个连起来，午文收尾，火蛋打讲堂后头的草人。
how.en: At the camera, make the seals one by one as Master Chu says, each held a moment; a wrong one, try again. All five learned, make four in a row ending on Wu, and the fire egg hits the straw dummy at the back of the hall.

how.zh: 往后拉，松手，把法术扔向讲堂后头的草人。火弹落地就炸；冰锥飞行中点一下，一分为三；金刃点一下，直冲出去，木头一刀两断。扔一回，丹田便空一截——四回。
how.en: Pull back and let go: throw the spells at the straw dummies at the back of the hall. The fireball bursts where it lands; tap the ice spike in flight and it splits in three; tap the gold blade and it shoots straight, cutting wood clean through. Each throw empties the dantian a notch: four throws.

done_line.zh: 草人倒了一排。丹田空了，手还在抖。
done_line.en: The straw dummies are down in a row. The dantian is empty; the hands still shake.

how.zh: 镜光扫过来之前冲过去：点一下跳，按住连跳，矮顶底下别跳。碰上了，从头。
how.en: Through before the mirror's light sweeps: tap to jump, hold to keep jumping, stay down under the low roofs. Touch one, start over.

tasks._game: Hanli 10-19 (「ai游戏放到游戏中吧……但要结合剧情」; 「AI猜都是Yinyue猜」): 娘 cannot read, so beside each line of his first letter home 小满 draws a small picture (games.json drawguess `sets.jiaxin`: the basins, 爹's bow, the moon over the mountain) and 银月 — out at the 火锅 that night — has to read it; a line counts as written once she names it, in words only when she does not. Never stuck on the model: she cannot be asked (a blind model, no engine, a 测试存档) and 「就写字吧」 writes it in words (`written`). Up to 3 looks a line, no opening look: ~8.7k tokens a look, 9 at most (~78k). Was the 写信 · 擦了又写 tap (games/letter.js, 游戏厅 only now).

title.en: The letter home · Drawn for Ma

deal.context: 腊八夜里，大通铺上，小满就着月光给家里写第一封信。娘不识字，他在每句旁边画一样东西

what.zh: 大比那天夜里，孙二狗托你替他写一封家信：「娘，我倒了七回，起来了七回。」别写是谁把他打倒的。
what.en: The night of the contest Sun Ergou asked you to write a letter home for him: "Mother, I fell down seven times and got up seven times." Not to write who knocked him down.
